description: This file contains macro definitions for generating functions that implement commit slabs, including initialization, clearing, deep clearing, and access functions for slab elements. It appears to be part of a larger C project related to commit data structures using slabs.
external_files: other project headers if referenced within macros

methods.name: init_slabname_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a slab with a specified stride, setting up size and slab count.

methods.name: init_slabname
methods.description: Initializes a slab with default stride of 1.

methods.name: clear_slabname
methods.description: Frees all slabs and resets the slab count.

methods.name: deep_clear_slabname
methods.description: Frees the contents of slabs using a user-provided free function and then clears slabs.

methods.name: slabname_at_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the slab element at a given commit, optionally adding if missing.

methods.name: slabname_at
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the slab element at a given commit, guaranteed to exist.

methods.name: slabname_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the slab element at a given commit, without adding if missing.
